newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FEB INFLATION DUE AT 1300 LOCAL (1100GMT).
newsitem.headline: GREEK FEB INFLATION DUE AT 1300 LOCAL (1100GMT).

text.p: Greece's February consumer price inflation is due to be released at 1300 local (1100GMT) and will be 6.5 percent year-on-year as expected, a National Statistics Service (NSS) official told Reuters.
The timing has been set to coincide with the announcement of January's harmonised EU inflation numbers for member countries by the EU commission in Brussels.
The NSS will have completed work on Greece's harmonised CPI index by end-1997, an official said.
National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou told parliament this week CPI-based inflation fell to 6.5 percent year-on-year in February from 6.8 percent in January.
An NSS official confirmed that consumer price inflation dropped to 6.5 percent in February.
"How can it be a different figure if the minister announced it in parliament," said the official. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
